text: This study extends previous Norwegian register-based work by showing substantial county-level variation in ADHD medication dispensing among children and adolescents. National averages may conceal important regional differences in recognition, referral pathways, diagnostic practice, treatment thresholds, prescribing practice, or service organisation. Further studies linking prescription data with diagnostic, clinical, service-level, and socioeconomic information are needed to clarify the drivers and consequences of these regional differences.
source_label: County-level variation and trajectories in ADHD medication dispensing among Norwegian children and adolescents, 2005-2022: a nationwide prescription register study
